editorial:
Imagine being a cop who is already in huge trouble, only to be given a secret mission to kill the people responsible for a national tragedy. That is exactly where you find Crisanto Espina. He is suspended and under investigation, making him the perfect tool for the higher-ups who want the bank robbery suspects gone without any legal fuss. The movie feels gritty and tense, putting you right in the middle of a world where the line between the good guys and the bad guys is completely blurred. You will feel the pressure building as he hunts down these criminals while trying to keep his own head above water.

What really works here is the acting and the way the tension keeps ramping up. The action scenes are punchy and don't overstay their welcome, though some parts of the plot move a bit slow. If you love crime stories with a dark edge, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a heavy realization that the system is corrupt. After hunting down the suspects, you find out that the people who hired him were just cleaning up their own mess to hide their involvement. In the final showdown, Crisanto faces the truth about who betrayed him. He takes out the real villains in a violent clash, choosing justice over following orders, which finally gives him a sense of peace despite the tragedy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark police stories and revenge plots.
